titre: Devoir de contrôle n°3 - Anglais (8ème année de base)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Last summer, my family and I visited the beautiful island of Djerba, in the south of Tunisia. We stayed there for one week in a nice hotel near the beach. Every morning, we swam in the clear blue sea and relaxed on the golden sand. We also visited the old market of Houmt Souk, where we bought pottery and traditional souvenirs. One day, we rode bikes around the island and saw many palm trees and white houses. In the evenings, we ate delicious Tunisian food in small restaurants. The people of Djerba were very kind and welcoming. It was an unforgettable holiday.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) Where did the family go last summer and for how long?   (2 marks)
2) What did they do every morning?   (2 marks)
3) What did they buy at the old market?   (2 marks)
4) What were the people of Djerba like?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Put the verbs in the past simple: We (swim) ______ in the sea and (visit) ______ the market.   (2 marks)
2) Give the past simple of: buy ______ ; ride ______.   (2 marks)
3) Give the opposite of "beautiful" = ______.   (1 mark)
4) Complete with a preposition (in / on / at): We stayed there ______ one week.   (1 mark)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
Write about a holiday or a trip you enjoyed (about 8 lines). Say where you went, what you did and how you felt. Use the past simple.
